# DigiDARA AI Agents

> DigiDARA AI Agents (https://digidaraaiagents.com) is an AI agent platform by DigiDARA Technologies. It offers specialized AI agents for education, careers, communication, travel, construction and other industries, and builds custom AI agents for businesses worldwide.

## What it offers
- Ready-made agents: Capstone Project, Coding Practice, Communication Coach, Aptitude Trainer, Mock Interview, Resume Builder, Job Fetching, AI Certification.
- Custom AI agents designed around a customer's industry workflow (travel, construction, healthcare, finance, education and more).
- One account for all agents, with chat history across devices, free to start.

## Audience
Individuals, students, job seekers, teams and companies anywhere in the world.
